scope: Optional original target feature capture plus offline tiny diagnostics; no graph math, weights, compiler flags or accuracy acceptance change.

native_contract.buffer: Target output[1] copied as exact little-endian FP16 bytes immediately after target Process and before draft Process
native_contract.default: No capture field or copied feature buffer

transport: Optional run_hdc.py --execution-only --capture-target-features; retain existing remote report SHA256 verification, source/OMC/reference/runner bindings and isolated deployment.

offline_contract.scope: Supported unquantized FP16 tiny configuration, sequence2..16
offline_contract.oracle: Current host neutral IR using actual hash-checked prepared FP16 payloads; not an OMG emulator
offline_contract.boundaries: Post-layer0 and post-layer2 features, each includes GDN, normalization, residuals and MoE
offline_contract.positions: Valid prompt only; padded positions excluded
offline_contract.output: Descriptive finite counts, max_abs, RMS, relativeL2 and per-token equality; no invented acceptance threshold
offline_contract.identity: Source payload identity/configuration plus original OMC/report/reference hashes; AIR document chain explicitly not verified

validation.independent_review: Provenance checks, FP16 byte preservation, capture lifecycle and valid-row/layer indexing reviewed; reference validation and oracle code hashes added. Existing target_features.py retained unchanged.

limitations: No internal DDK cross-build or real board feature retrieval performed locally.
Device first divergence and GDN responsibility remain undetermined.
Complete model accuracy, placement, memory and speedup remain unvalidated.
